meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将个人微信接入你的应用,扫码即可收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想给项目加上个人微信消息收发能力。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your app to personal WeChat via official API for messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs personal WeChat messaging.

howto.what: 装上后会把你的个人微信通过腾讯官方 iLink Bot API 接成一条渠道:长轮询收消息、手机扫码登录,不需要 webhook 或付费 token。扫码成功后,微信消息交给 agent 处理并回复。
howto.when: 当你安装这个技能、设置 WECHAT_ENABLED=true 并重启服务,日志里出现待扫二维码时;也用于把某个微信联系人/群接到 agent 时。

say.text: 帮我把个人微信接入 NanoClaw
把刚给我发消息的那个微信联系人接到 agent
微信提示 session expired,帮我重新登录
say.note: 删除 auth.json 并重启,重新扫码

howto.what_en: Wires your personal WeChat into NanoClaw via Tencent's official iLink Bot API: long-polling messages and phone QR login, no webhook or paid token. After the scan, WeChat messages reach the agent, which replies.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you install the skill and enable WECHAT_ENABLED=true, then restart and a QR code appears in the logs; also when wiring a WeChat contact or group to an agent.

say_en.text: Connect my personal WeChat to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Starts QR login and saves credentials to data/wechat/auth.json

say_en.text: Wire the WeChat contact who just messaged me to an agent
say_en.note: Runs the wire-dm script to pick an agent group

say_en.text: WeChat says session expired, re-log me in
say_en.note: Deletes auth.json, restarts, asks for a new scan
